BranchFile.purpose: Master list of branches. Branch codes are stored in transaction tables; join here to show the branch name.
BranchFile.mainJoin: BranchFile.BranchCode = transaction Branch / BranchCode / TargetBranch / Branchto
BranchFile.importantRule: Use Type='D' for transaction/detail branches. Type='C' is a control/parent branch. Show BranchName to users, not only codes.

fields.name: BranchCode
fields.meaning: Unique branch code used in transaction tables.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: BranchName
fields.meaning: Branch display name. Join by BranchCode and show this name in reports.

fields.name: Type
fields.meaning: Branch level: 'C' = Control/parent, 'D' = Detail/transaction branch.
fields.rule: C=Control/parent; D=Detail/transaction branch.

fields.name: DetCode
fields.meaning: Parent/control branch code for this branch.

StockRoom.purpose: Master list of stockrooms / warehouses. A branch can have multiple stockrooms.
StockRoom.importantRule: Use Type='D' for transaction stockrooms. A branch may have multiple stockrooms. Show Name to users.

fields.name: Code
fields.meaning: Unique stockroom / warehouse code used in transaction tables.

fields.name: Name
fields.meaning: Stockroom / warehouse display name.

fields.name: Type
fields.meaning: Stockroom level: 'C' = Control/parent, 'D' = Detail/transaction stockroom.
fields.rule: C=Control/parent; D=Detail/transaction stockroom.

fields.name: DetCode
fields.meaning: Parent/control stockroom code.

fields.name: Branch
fields.meaning: Branch code that owns this stockroom. One branch can have multiple stockrooms.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

BarcodeView.purpose: Main product/barcode view. Use it to translate a barcode into product attributes such as design, brand, supplier, category, color, size, season and prices.
BarcodeView.importantRule: Use transaction-time prices from transaction detail tables for historical calculations; do not replace them with current BarcodeView prices.

PosPurchaseM.purpose: Purchase invoice header. Contains supplier, invoice date, branch and invoice-level totals. A saved purchase increases stock.
PosPurchaseM.importantRule: Supplier name comes from AccountList using PartyCode. Pair Purchase Amount with Purchase Quantity in reports.

fields.name: TransactionNumber
fields.meaning: Document number for the purchase invoice; links to the matching detail table.
fields.rule: Main document number; join to matching detail/payment rows.

fields.name: Date
fields.meaning: Date of the purchase invoice. Stock is increased from this date.

fields.name: PartyCode
fields.meaning: Supplier account code for the purchase invoice; join AccountList.ActCod to get supplier name.
fields.rule: Join AccountList.ActCod when an account/party name is needed.

fields.name: BillGrossAmount
fields.meaning: Gross document amount before discount, tax and other charges; normally Quantity × Rate total.

fields.name: STAmount
fields.meaning: Total sales tax amount on the document.

fields.name: StAddAmount
fields.meaning: Total additional sales tax amount on the document.

fields.name: DiscAmount
fields.meaning: Total discount amount on the document.

fields.name: ValExclSalesTax
fields.meaning: Document value excluding sales tax: gross amount minus discount.

fields.name: ValInclSalesTax
fields.meaning: Document value including sales tax: value excluding tax + sales tax + additional sales tax.

fields.name: AddOtherCharges
fields.meaning: Additional document-level charges added to the bill.

fields.name: LessOtherCharges
fields.meaning: Document-level charges deducted from the bill.

fields.name: AddPercent
fields.meaning: Percentage used for additional charges, when applicable.

fields.name: LessPercent
fields.meaning: Percentage used for deducted charges, when applicable.

fields.name: billamount
fields.meaning: Final bill amount after discount, taxes and add/less other charges.

fields.name: TotalQuantity
fields.meaning: Total purchased quantity on the invoice.

fields.name: Branch
fields.meaning: Branch code where the purchase invoice was created.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: LessAccount
fields.meaning: Account code used for deducted/less other charges.
fields.rule: Join AccountList.ActCod when an account/party name is needed.

fields.name: AddAccount
fields.meaning: Account code used for added other charges.
fields.rule: Join AccountList.ActCod when an account/party name is needed.

PosPurchaseD.purpose: Purchase invoice line items. Contains barcode, quantity, rate, tax, discount, branch and destination stockroom.
PosPurchaseD.importantRule: For line-level purchase value use DetBillAmount when final allocated charges are required.

fields.name: TransactionNumber
fields.meaning: Document number linking this line to the purchase master/header.
fields.rule: Join to the matching master/header TransactionNumber.

fields.name: BarCode
fields.meaning: Barcode of the product being purchased; join BarcodeView for product details.
fields.rule: Join BarcodeView.BarCode for product attributes.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.meaning: Quantity purchased for this barcode.

fields.name: Rate
fields.meaning: Unit rate used for this purchase line.

fields.name: GrossAmount
fields.meaning: Line gross amount before discount and tax: Quantity × Rate.

fields.name: DiscountPercent
fields.meaning: Discount percentage on this line.

fields.name: DiscountAmount
fields.meaning: Discount amount on this line.

fields.name: ValueExcludingST
fields.meaning: Line value excluding sales tax: Quantity × Rate - DiscountAmount.

fields.name: SalesTaxPer
fields.meaning: Sales tax percentage on this line.

fields.name: AddSalesTaxPer
fields.meaning: Additional sales tax percentage on this line.

fields.name: SalesTaxAmount
fields.meaning: Sales tax amount on this line.

fields.name: AddSalesTaxAmount
fields.meaning: Additional sales tax amount on this line.

fields.name: ValueIncludingST
fields.meaning: Line value including sales taxes: ValueExcludingST + SalesTaxAmount + AddSalesTaxAmount.

fields.name: Branch
fields.meaning: Branch code for this purchase line.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: StoreCode
fields.meaning: Stockroom / warehouse where purchased stock is added.
fields.rule: Join StockRoom.Code to show stockroom Name.

fields.name: DetLessOtherCharges
fields.meaning: Share of document-level less/deducted other charges allocated to this line.

fields.name: DetAddOtherCharges
fields.meaning: Share of document-level added other charges allocated to this line.

fields.name: DetBillAmount
fields.meaning: Final line bill amount after discount, tax and allocated add/less other charges.

PosTransferM.purpose: Stock transfer header between branches. Source stock leaves when the transfer is created. Cancelled transfers must be ignored.
PosTransferM.stockEffect: Move stock; source leaves on transfer date

fields.name: TransactionNumber
fields.meaning: Stock transfer document number; links to PosTransferD.
fields.rule: Main document number; join to matching detail/payment rows.

fields.name: TransactionDate
fields.meaning: Transfer creation date. Source-branch stock is removed from this date.

fields.name: Branch
fields.meaning: Source branch code (stock moves out from this branch).
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: Branchto
fields.meaning: Destination branch code (stock will be received by this branch).
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: TotalRetailAmt
fields.meaning: Total retail-value amount of all transferred lines.

fields.name: TotalWsAmt
fields.meaning: Total wholesale-value amount of all transferred lines.

fields.name: TotalQuantity
fields.meaning: Total quantity sent in the transfer.

fields.name: Cancel
fields.meaning: Transfer cancellation flag. 'Y' means cancelled; exclude it from reports.
fields.rule: Exclude rows/documents where Cancel='Y'.

PosTransferD.purpose: Barcode-level transfer lines. Destination stock is added only when the line is received (RecStatus='Y') using RecDate and RecQuantity.
PosTransferD.stockEffect: Source OUT by Quantity; destination IN by RecQuantity only when received
PosTransferD.importantRule: Ignore Cancel='Y'. Destination stock must not be added before RecStatus='Y'. RecDate controls destination stock date.

fields.name: TransactionNumber
fields.meaning: Transfer document number linking this line to PosTransferM.
fields.rule: Join to the matching master/header TransactionNumber.

fields.name: BarCode
fields.meaning: Transferred barcode; join BarcodeView for product details.
fields.rule: Join BarcodeView.BarCode for product attributes.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.meaning: Quantity sent from the source branch/store.

fields.name: CostPrice
fields.meaning: Cost price captured at the time of transfer; use this historical value for transfer reporting.

fields.name: PurchasePrice
fields.meaning: Purchase price captured at the time of transfer.

fields.name: WholesalePrice
fields.meaning: Wholesale price captured at the time of transfer.

fields.name: RetailPrice
fields.meaning: Retail price captured at the time of transfer.

fields.name: StoreCodeFrom
fields.meaning: Source stockroom code where stock is removed.
fields.rule: Join StockRoom.Code to show stockroom Name.

fields.name: StoreCodeTo
fields.meaning: Destination stockroom code where stock will be added when received.
fields.rule: Join StockRoom.Code to show stockroom Name.

fields.name: Branch
fields.meaning: Source branch code.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: Branchto
fields.meaning: Destination branch code.
fields.rule: Join BranchFile.BranchCode to show BranchName.

fields.name: RetailAmount
fields.meaning: Transfer retail value: Quantity × RetailPrice.

fields.name: WsAmount
fields.meaning: Transfer wholesale value: Quantity × WholesalePrice.

fields.name: RecStatus

businessRules.Rule: Use exact database table and field names in SQL. Do not correct database spellings such as Catagory/CatagoryName.
businessRules.Why / Example: The English descriptions are for understanding; SQL must use the real names.

businessRules.Rule: Excel sheet 'PosCategoryWiseSalesmanIncentiv' is truncated because Excel sheet names are limited to 31 characters. The actual database table name is PosCategoryWiseSalesmanIncentive.
businessRules.Why / Example: Always use PosCategoryWiseSalesmanIncentive in SQL.

businessRules.Rule: Show names to business users instead of raw codes whenever a name table exists.
businessRules.Why / Example: Branch -> BranchFile.BranchName; StockRoom -> StockRoom.Name; Barcode -> BarcodeView attributes; Account -> AccountList.AcName; Employee -> Employee.Name.

businessRules.Rule: Only detail branches (BranchFile.Type='D') are transaction branches. Control branches (Type='C') are parents/heads.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not treat control branches as stores with transactions.

businessRules.Rule: Only detail stockrooms (StockRoom.Type='D') are transaction stockrooms. One branch can have multiple stockrooms.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use StockRoom.Branch to understand branch ownership.

businessRules.Rule: For paid sales reports, use BillStatus='P'. BillStatus='C' is cancelled and must be excluded.
businessRules.Why / Example: H=Hold and U=Unpaid are not paid sales.

businessRules.Rule: SalesType='S' means Sale and SalesType='R' means Return.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not confuse BillStatus with SalesType.

businessRules.Rule: Sale/return detail quantities and amounts are signed. Return rows can already be negative.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not multiply return rows by -1 again unless a specific report intentionally converts to absolute values.

businessRules.Rule: Exclude POS/UnPOS detail rows where Cancel='Y'.
businessRules.Why / Example: A deleted line can remain in the database with Cancel='Y'.

businessRules.Rule: UnPos tables are live/before daily closing; Pos tables are closed/historical after daily closing.
businessRules.Why / Example: When combining both, protect against duplicate bills that have moved from UnPos to Pos.

businessRules.Rule: For management final-sales reconciliation, DetPaidCash + DetPaidCard + DetPaidCredit can be used at detail level when the report needs allocated final paid value.
businessRules.Why / Example: These detail payment allocations reconcile line items to final bill payment.

businessRules.Rule: For historical COGS/profit, use transaction-time PurchasePrice from PosDetail/UnPosDetail.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not use current BarcodeView.PurchasePrice for old sales.

businessRules.Rule: Payment method codes: 1=Cash, 2=Card, 3=Credit.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use PosPayment/UnPosPayment for payment-method breakdown.

businessRules.Rule: A saved purchase increases stock on PosPurchaseM.Date.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use PosPurchaseD.Quantity at Branch + StoreCode.

businessRules.Rule: A purchase return decreases stock on PosPReturnM.Date.
businessRules.Why / Example: Subtract PosPReturnD.Quantity from Branch + StoreCode.

businessRules.Rule: PosPReturnD.StoreCode is the source stockroom from which returned stock is removed.
businessRules.Why / Example: This resolves an inconsistent wording in the source structure sheet.

businessRules.Rule: Source stock is removed when the transfer is created on PosTransferM.TransactionDate.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use PosTransferD.Quantity at Branch + StoreCodeFrom.

businessRules.Rule: Destination stock is added only for received lines: RecStatus='Y'.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use RecDate as stock-in date and RecQuantity as received quantity at Branchto + StoreCodeTo.

businessRules.Rule: Ignore cancelled transfer master/detail rows where Cancel='Y'.
businessRules.Why / Example: Cancelled transfers/lines must not affect stock or reporting.

businessRules.Rule: Stock take records physical counts only and does not directly change stock.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use stock adjustment documents for stock effect after reconciliation.

businessRules.Rule: EntryType='IN' adds stock; EntryType='OUT' removes stock.
businessRules.Why / Example: Ignore adjustment master/detail rows where Cancel='Y'.

businessRules.Rule: PosBarOpen.Quantity is opening stock by barcode, branch and stockroom.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use it as the starting point of current-stock calculations.

businessRules.Rule: Current Stock = Opening + Purchase - Purchase Return - signed Sales Quantity - Transfer Out + Transfer Received + Stock Adjustment IN - Stock Adjustment OUT.
businessRules.Why / Example: Stock Take is not directly included in this movement formula.

businessRules.Rule: BarcodeView is the product master/view for names and merchandise attributes.
businessRules.Why / Example: Join by BarCode to obtain brand, supplier, category, color, size, season, etc.

businessRules.Rule: Transaction detail tables store prices captured at transaction time.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use those prices for historical reports instead of current product-master prices.

businessRules.Rule: AccountList.ActCod is the account key; use AcName for display.
businessRules.Why / Example: Suppliers/customers/expenses and other accounts are classified in AccountList.

businessRules.Rule: PosBranchIncentive contains branch amount targets: Benchmark, FirstTarget, SecondTarget, ThirdTarget.
businessRules.Why / Example: TargetBranch is the branch to which the target applies.

businessRules.Rule: PosSalesmanIncentive contains salesman amount targets linked to a branch target.
businessRules.Why / Example: SalesmanCode joins Employee.Code; TargetTranNo links to PosBranchIncentive.TranNo.

businessRules.Rule: PosCategoryIncentive uses quantity targets for a selected dimension such as Supplier, Category or Brand.
businessRules.Why / Example: MasterCode chooses the dimension type; CategoryCode chooses the value.

businessRules.Rule: PosCategoryWiseSalesmanIncentive uses quantity targets for each salesman inside a selected dimension/category.
businessRules.Why / Example: CategoryTranNo links to PosCategoryIncentive.TranNo; SalesmanCode joins Employee.Code.

businessRules.Rule: IncentiveType='P' means Percentage and 'A' means fixed Amount.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not assume whether 0.10 means 0.10% or 10%; follow stored system calculation/confirmed business logic.

businessRules.Rule: Status='Y' is active and Status='N' is inactive.
businessRules.Why / Example: Inactive incentive policies must be ignored.

businessRules.Rule: PosTargetMaster defines management levels; source examples include Country Manager, Regional Sales Manager, Area Sales Manager and Branch Manager.
businessRules.Why / Example: PosTargetDetail.MasterCode selects the level.

businessRules.Why / Example: Use IsActive=1 for active hierarchy assignments.

businessRules.Why / Example: BranchCode joins BranchFile.BranchCode.

businessRules.Why / Example: They are listed as 'Sample-only / meaning not documented'. Future AI must ask for clarification before using them in calculations.

businessRules.Rule: Exact SQL data types, indexes and database primary-key constraints are not provided in the source workbook.
businessRules.Why / Example: This guide documents business meaning, joins and calculation rules, not physical SQL schema types.

businessRules.Rule: PosDiscount.Status='Y' means active. Status='N' means inactive and the policy must be skipped.
businessRules.Why / Example: Do not apply inactive discount policies.

businessRules.Rule: A policy is date-valid only when the business/requested date is between DisFrom and DisTo, inclusive.
businessRules.Why / Example: Outside the validity window the policy must not be applied.

businessRules.Rule: DisPolicy values documented by source: F=Flat, U=Upto, S=Seasonal. DisPercent stores the discount percentage for the barcode.
businessRules.Why / Example: Use the stored policy type and percentage exactly; do not invent additional policy codes.

businessRules.Rule: DisBranch contains the branches where the policy applies. The same barcode can exist in multiple policies; the source states that the latest applicable policy wins.
businessRules.Why / Example: Match full branch-code tokens in DisBranch. TransactionDate indicates recency; exact tie-break behavior for equal-date policies is not documented.

queryGuide.Example User Question: What are today's total sales and quantity?
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter paid bills (BillStatus='P'), exclude cancelled lines, combine POS + UnPOS without duplicates, sum signed sales value and signed quantity.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return Net Sales + Net Quantity.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show branch-wise sales for 1 Aug to 31 Aug.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Date filter, paid bills, signed returns, group by Branch and join BranchName.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Show every matching branch unless user asks for Top N.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Group by StoreCode and join StockRoom.Name; keep branch context.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return sales + quantity by stockroom/store.

queryGuide.Tables: PosBarOpen, PosPurchaseD, PosPReturnD, Pos/UnPosDetail, PosTransferD/M, PosStockAdjD/M, BranchFile, StockRoom
queryGuide.Key Logic: Opening + Purchase - Purchase Return - signed Sales Qty - Transfer Out + Received Transfer + IN Adjustment - OUT Adjustment.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return total stock and branch/store breakdown.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show product details for barcode X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter BarcodeView.BarCode and return product names/attributes.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Prefer display-name fields such as BrandName, CatagoryName, ColorName, SizeName.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show purchase amount and quantity this month.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter PosPurchaseM.Date; sum quantity and purchase value. Supplier from AccountList if needed.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Always pair Purchase Amount with Purchase Qty.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Group by PartyCode and join AccountList.AcName.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return supplier name, purchase amount and quantity.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show purchase return amount and quantity this month.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter return date; sum return quantity and final return value.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return both Purchase Return Amount and Return Qty.

queryGuide.Tables: PosPurchaseM + PosPurchaseD + AccountList + BarcodeView + BranchFile + StockRoom
queryGuide.Key Logic: Match TransactionNumber; join supplier, branch, stockroom and product names.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Show header plus item lines.

queryGuide.Tables: PosPReturnM + PosPReturnD + AccountList + BarcodeView + BranchFile + StockRoom
queryGuide.Key Logic: Match TransactionNumber; return stock is OUT from StoreCode.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Show header plus returned item lines.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show sale bill AMS... complete detail.
queryGuide.Tables: PosMaster/PosDetail/PosPayment; if still live use UnPos equivalents
queryGuide.Key Logic: Identify exact bill, prefer paid bill, include branch, customer, item, qty, amounts and payment details.
queryGuide.Expected Output: If bill type is ambiguous, ask Sale/Purchase/Transfer.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Paymethod 1=Cash, 2=Card, 3=Credit; group by method.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return cash, card and credit totals.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Group by SalesManAccount, join Employee.Name, use signed sale/return values.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return salesman name, net sales and net quantity.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Exclude Cancel='Y'; sent uses Quantity, received uses RecQuantity only where RecStatus='Y'.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return sent qty, received qty and in-transit difference.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Exclude cancelled; lines with RecStatus<>'Y' or sent quantity not fully received are not yet received.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Show source, destination, barcode, sent qty, received qty, transfer date.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Exclude cancelled; do not treat physical count as stock movement.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return physical count quantity/value only.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Exclude cancelled; EntryType IN positive, OUT negative.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return IN, OUT and net adjustment quantities.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Use Type='D' for detail/transaction branches.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return BranchName and code.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter StockRoom.Branch and usually Type='D'.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return stockroom names.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show all counters for branch X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter PosIdMap.BranchCode; CounterName -> PosDetailFile.Code where MasterCode='025'.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return all counter values; one branch can have multiple counters.

queryGuide.Key Logic: The current workbook does not document which POS transaction field maps a bill to PosIdMap.Code.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Do not guess. Ask for the transaction-to-counter field before building this report.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter Status='Y' and date within PeriodFrom/PeriodTo; targets are amounts.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Show Benchmark/First/Second/Third target and incentive type/value.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show salesman incentive for employee X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter active period/status; join SalesmanCode to Employee.Code.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Targets are amount-based.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show category incentive for Brand/Supplier/Category X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: MasterCode identifies dimension; CategoryCode identifies value; filter Status='Y'.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Targets are quantity-based.

queryGuide.Tables: PosCategoryWiseSalesmanIncentive + PosCategoryIncentive + PosBranchIncentive + Employee + PosMasterFile + PosDetailFile
queryGuide.Key Logic: CategoryTranNo links category policy; SalesmanCode links employee; TargetTranNo links branch target.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Targets are quantity-based per salesman within the selected dimension.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show management hierarchy for Branch X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Use active PosTargetDetail rows; resolve MasterCode hierarchy level, HOD self-link and employee name.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return Country Manager/RSM/ASM/Branch Manager chain where data supports it.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show COGS and profit by product.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Use signed Quantity × transaction-time PurchasePrice for COGS; use signed sales value for revenue.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Never use current BarcodeView.PurchasePrice for historical COGS.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Join barcode to BrandName/CatagoryName and group by selected merchandise attribute.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return amount + quantity; returns remain signed.

queryGuide.Key Logic: Calculate current quantity first. Value method must be explicitly defined (purchase price, retail, weighted average, etc.).
queryGuide.Expected Output: If valuation method is not specified, ask before calculating money value.

queryGuide.Example User Question: What discount applies to barcode X at branch Y today?
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter Barcode, Status='Y', requested date within DisFrom/DisTo, and requested branch as an exact token inside DisBranch. If multiple policies qualify, use the latest applicable policy.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return policy type, discount percent, validity period, applicable branch and product details.

queryGuide.Example User Question: Show all active discount policies for branch X.
queryGuide.Key Logic: Filter Status='Y', date validity if a date is requested, and branch token inside DisBranch. Join BarcodeView for readable product names.
queryGuide.Expected Output: Return policy number, barcode/product, type, discount percent, validity dates and branches.
